'''Pel''' is a wagon driver who was present in [[Duranda Tharne]]'s inn in [[Lugard]] when [[Siuan Sanche]] visited.

==Activities==
Mistress [[Duranda Tharne]] embarrassed Siuan by talking about her legs to Pel. Siuan was there to get information about the Blue Ajah but did not come at the appropriate time.{{ref/book|5|11}}
